selection_rule: First 20 exact original index-inventory-only records, preserving original order

source_download_manifest.extraction: BeautifulSoup; remove script/style/nav; headings/paragraphs/list-items/captions; whitespace normalized; omit nested duplicate paragraphs

sources.title: Activation Oracles: Training and Evaluating LLMs as General-Purpose Activation Explainers
sources.coverage_detail: Activation-injection QA, evaluation generalization, training-data scaling, and explicit non-mechanistic limitations.
sources.methods_or_content: Trains a language model to answer questions about injected target-model activations, then tests transfer to auditing tasks.
sources.limitations: The explainer can construct an inference absent from the target, confabulate, and cannot establish representation geometry or computational mechanism.
sources.mira_implication_inference: An expressive explainer would be an additional readout, not evidence that MIRA uses a physical coordinate.

sources.title: Building and evaluating alignment auditing agents
sources.coverage_detail: Main experimental design, selected agent/tool comparisons and discussion, common limitations; appendix not read.
sources.methods_or_content: Tests auditing agents against implanted behaviors and compares access to tools across repeated investigations.
sources.limitations: Synthetic issues, development/test contamination, early-hypothesis fixation and unrealistic generated evaluations limit transfer.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Preserve independent checks and explicit alternative hypotheses; successful automation does not certify scientific coverage.

sources.title: Thread: Circuits
sources.coverage_detail: Landing-page framing, article summaries and thread-format caveat only; linked articles not read.
sources.methods_or_content: Organizes detailed investigations of features, connections, and recurring vision-model structures.
sources.limitations: This is an exploratory collection index; its summaries do not substitute for evidence in each linked article.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Family structure motivates entity-conditioned studies, but this landing page adds no MIRA-specific validation.

sources.title: Distill Hiatus
sources.coverage_detail: Publication/editorial rationale only; not a technical model study.
sources.methods_or_content: Explains Distill publishing and mentoring tradeoffs and its announced hiatus.
sources.limitations: Contains no model experiment or interpretability-method comparison.
sources.mira_implication_inference: No new technical diagnosis; clear reproducible publication remains useful.

sources.title: Transformer Circuit Exercises
sources.coverage_detail: Introduction and exercise statements; solutions, notebooks and parameter implementations not executed.
sources.methods_or_content: Constructs attention-head weights for copying, virtual-head composition and induction algorithms.
sources.limitations: Hand-built pedagogical mechanisms are not recovered circuits in a trained video model.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Useful for validating hook and routing intuition, not for inferring that MIRA contains the same algorithm.

sources.title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
sources.coverage_detail: Summary, model simplifications, residual communication, QK/OV separation, composition checks and limitations; not all derivations/appendices.
sources.methods_or_content: Separates attention routing from value movement and uses matrix paths plus targeted term ablations.
sources.limitations: Small attention-only models and frozen attention simplify analysis; MLP and normalization interactions limit extension.
sources.mira_implication_inference: A changed block output does not identify its upstream writer or downstream reader; component/routing localization remains open.

sources.title: Garcon
sources.coverage_detail: Hook interface, persistent captures, server-side reductions, implementation/performance discussion.
sources.methods_or_content: Keeps model servers loaded and supports named read/modify hooks and local tensor reductions.
sources.limitations: An infrastructure interface supplies access, not scientific evidence about a representation.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Our persistent workers and pooled captures follow this efficiency principle; every reduction still needs its own information-loss audit.

sources.title: Transformer Circuit Videos
sources.coverage_detail: All textual landing-page content read; embedded videos and playlist not watched.
sources.methods_or_content: Introduces informal early transformer-circuit talks and points to a later mathematical paper.
sources.limitations: The page warns the material is preliminary and partly superseded; no video-content review is claimed.
sources.mira_implication_inference: No separate method or new diagnosis inferred from unviewed videos.

sources.title: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
sources.coverage_detail: Evidence hierarchy, architectural perturbations, ablation confounds, extrapolation limits and ablation-method subsection.
sources.methods_or_content: Combines developmental co-occurrence, architectural changes and head ablations; distinguishes full from pattern-preserving interventions.
sources.limitations: Redundancy and shifted MLP statistics complicate ablations; large-model evidence is more indirect.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Keep full downstream responses and specificity controls; one-site marginal effects do not establish necessity of the whole physical computation.

sources.title: Mechanistic Interpretability, Variables, and the Importance of Interpretable Bases
sources.coverage_detail: Main variable/basis argument and feature-definition discussion; no empirical replication.
sources.methods_or_content: Frames interpretation as identifying independently understandable activation variables and operations using them.
sources.limitations: Program-variable analogies and feature definitions are hypotheses, not an operational proof of decomposition.
sources.mira_implication_inference: A physical probe coefficient is a readout; interpreting it as a model variable requires additional causal structure.

sources.title: Softmax Linear Units
sources.coverage_detail: SoLU construction, blinded quick-interpretation evaluation, later metric caveat, LayerNorm hiding and discussion.
sources.methods_or_content: Changes activation functions and assesses neuron interpretability with blinded annotators and additional activation-range inspection.
sources.limitations: Strong-activation examples can miss polysemantic low-activation behavior; post-SoLU normalization can expose hidden components.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Feature semantics need positives, negatives and multiple activation ranges. A handful of attractive examples would not validate ball/velocity features.

sources.title: Toy Models of Superposition
sources.coverage_detail: Sparse synthetic setup, linear-feature definitions, correlation geometry and limits of extrapolation; no full appendix or notebook execution.
sources.methods_or_content: Varies feature sparsity, importance and correlations in bottleneck networks with known synthetic features.
sources.limitations: Correlated factors may merge; geometry and learning dynamics need not transfer to real networks.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Inspect physical nuisance correlations and value families; neither sparse-looking geometry nor a low-dimensional fit proves independent physical coordinates.

sources.title: Interpretability Dreams
sources.coverage_detail: Epistemic-foundation argument, feature families, universality and speculative end goals.
sources.methods_or_content: Explains how correlated precursor features can support a probe before the hypothesized higher-level feature exists.
sources.limitations: The proposed hierarchy, universality and scalability agenda is explicitly speculative.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Use the current successful decoders as evidence of readable annotations, not proof of a dedicated physical-state feature.

sources.title: Circuits Updates - July 2023
sources.coverage_detail: Finite-data optimization correction and revised interpretation of the skip-trigram example.
sources.methods_or_content: Revisits a confusing toy regime with optimization changes and derives a two-head cancellation algorithm.
sources.limitations: Earlier intermediate-regime and attention-superposition interpretations were revised; tiny-model behavior is not general evidence.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Distinguish optimization failure from representational limits; keep abandoned explanations visible when new evidence changes the account.

sources.title: Circuits Updates — May 2023
sources.coverage_detail: Dictionary learning, factorization/offset concerns, feature pressure, weight/attention superposition, and manifold toy experiment.
sources.methods_or_content: Studies sparse factorization, dictionary-size tradeoffs and length-scale-dependent discretization of circular feature families.
sources.limitations: Expressive recovery may invent composites; correlated factors and optimization can obscure the intended structure. Its attention claim is revisited in July.
sources.mira_implication_inference: A global affine/quadratic fit can miss value-specific feature families; any alternative needs a new frozen development comparison.

sources.title: Privileged Bases in the Transformer Residual Stream
sources.coverage_detail: Outlier/kurtosis tests, rotation and normalization hypotheses, and qualified optimizer conclusion.
sources.methods_or_content: Uses orthogonal rotations and modified normalization to isolate coordinate alignment in a trained transformer.
sources.limitations: Optimizer responsibility remains provisional; coordinate outliers are not by themselves interpretable features.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Do not read large residual coordinates as physical variables or treat this study as evidence that MIRA precision caused weak readouts.

sources.title: Distributed Representations: Composition & Superposition
sources.coverage_detail: Full note text, including toy-code examples and informal-status limitation.
sources.methods_or_content: Distinguishes independent feature composition from dense storage; shows a linear probe can decode color from combination-specific units.
sources.limitations: Toy binary codes are illustrative and definitions are informal.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Even a good ball-height probe may combine unrelated cues. Conditional feature transfer is stronger evidence than decoding alone.

sources.title: Superposition, Memorization, and Double Descent
sources.coverage_detail: Finite-data setup, data-point versus generalizing features, dataset-size/width behavior and main limitations.
sources.methods_or_content: Varies finite training data in a reconstruction toy model and contrasts memorized examples with generalizing factors.
sources.limitations: Special low-dimensional data and optimization choices drive the demonstration; no universal convergence threshold follows.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Nearby frames are correlated evidence. Held-match tests help, but the fixed sparse budget does not establish convergence or universal failure.

sources.title: Circuits Updates - April 2024
sources.coverage_detail: Compute/training updates, structured feature-perturbation controls, and attribution-dictionary proposal; other reports/references not read.
sources.methods_or_content: Studies training budgets and compares feature interventions with random, feature-space and structured dampening controls.
sources.limitations: Isotropic random edits can be weak under anisotropy; reconstruction loss is an imperfect proxy and attribution-aware training is a proposal.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Add covariance/subspace-matched controls only in a new protocol; the present isotropic control is valid but incomplete.

sources.title: Circuits Updates - August 2024
sources.coverage_detail: Contrastive/sort evaluation designs, variant comparison caveats and self-explanation experiments.
sources.methods_or_content: Tests explanations through contrastive prompts and held activation examples, then compares several SAE variants.
sources.limitations: Metrics cover limited notions of meaning; nearby variants are hard to distinguish and self-explanations depend on scale.
sources.mira_implication_inference: Activation prediction and selectivity across matched cases remain untested semantic checks; reconstruction alone cannot rank interpretability.

untested_diagnoses.status: specific additional control not yet tested
untested_diagnoses.diagnosis: Norm matching alone does not match activation anisotropy.
untested_diagnoses.local_evidence: random_norm samples an isotropic normal1536 vector before raw-lift norm matching.
untested_diagnoses.future_test: Freeze discovery-covariance or dictionary-span random controls, with the same raw intervention norm and conditioning, before new outcome access.
untested_diagnoses.not_established: No evidence here that anisotropy explains the measured effects.

untested_diagnoses.diagnosis: Equal fixed training budgets do not establish convergence or a matched reconstruction frontier.
untested_diagnoses.local_evidence: All30 dictionaries use1000updates, one width, two activity budgets and final checkpoints only.
untested_diagnoses.future_test: A new development-only compute/width/step comparison with fixed held-match checks; retain all results.
untested_diagnoses.not_established: The literature does not show these dictionaries are undertrained or promise improvement from longer training.

untested_diagnoses.diagnosis: Readable physical labels can be assembled from context cues rather than an independently used feature.
untested_diagnoses.local_evidence: Selected descriptor covers a whole view; no object localization/visibility track is claimed.
untested_diagnoses.future_test: Predeclare matched positive/negative visual cases and evaluate activation ranges, visibility and feature selectivity.
untested_diagnoses.not_established: These papers do not establish a dedicated ball-state variable in MIRA.

untested_diagnoses.diagnosis: A global scalar map may miss context-dependent or value-specific physical feature families.
untested_diagnoses.local_evidence: Registered geometry compares fixed affine/quadratic or harmonic maps while nuisance state and camera vary.
untested_diagnoses.future_test: A new development-only value-binned and nuisance-conditioned comparison, with held values/matches and later exact interventions.
untested_diagnoses.not_established: No nonlinear manifold has been established; a flexible fit can create its own explanatory pattern.

untested_diagnoses.diagnosis: A block-output intervention does not identify the writer/reader computation or all relevant times.
untested_diagnoses.local_evidence: The current rollout edits exactly one block15 output/view0 at one denoising step for the first generated latent.
untested_diagnoses.future_test: Separately register component/routing, context-length or denoising-time contrasts after the current fixed study.
untested_diagnoses.not_established: No claim that another site/time will improve steering; current outcomes must not select a new confirmation hypothesis.

existing_controls_not_replaced: Fresh held-match decoding with frozen choices
Discovery-mean descriptor controls exposing the native complement
Registered generated rollouts and independent learned-video measurement
current_claim_boundary: The completed conditional-fidelity mean control already exposes preserved native-complement information. Additional reading does not repair this into feature sufficiency, validate generated-video physical accuracy, or establish nonlinear coordinates.
limitations: Text was inspected only for the listed line ranges, with headings surveyed to choose relevant sections.
HTML and normalized extracted-text hashes identify the cached source bytes; extraction can omit custom interactive/equation rendering.
No exhaustive appendix reading, linked-paper/reference reading, notebook execution, interactive manipulation or video watching is claimed.
Raw copyrighted HTML/text stays in the local source cache; public documentation cites original pages.
Applications and proposed diagnoses for MIRA are our inferences, not empirical findings about MIRA from these papers.
